scene.text: Traditional Chinese ink-and-watercolour painting: confident dark ink-brush linework, loose expressive brushwork, soft bleeding colour washes, visible paper grain. Faces, hands and skin are built the same way as everything else — flat washes and visible brushstrokes, edges left unresolved where the brush lifted. Wide shot looking upward at the upper portion of a neoclassical building with tall Corinthian columns and an ornate entablature, occupying the right half of the frame, set against a deep solid blue sky. A large, billowing red fabric or flag sweeps across the lower-left portion of the frame in a bold curved shape, partially obscuring the base of the composition. The building is rendered in cool grey-white tones.
